title: Two Coats of Confidence with Ronnie Delacroix
description: Ronnie answers listeners' home repair letters with total confidence and zero competence. Every problem, leak, crack, or gas smell, gets the same fix: just paint over it. Barry tries, and fails, to fact-check him.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Two Coats of Confidence. You write the letters, I solve the house. Barry, first one.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Maureen writes, quote, a brown water stain keeps spreading across my ceiling, and it's bigger every morning.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's the ceiling expressing itself, Maureen. Match the stain with a ceiling-colored paint and it blends right in.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [question-en] Ronnie, where is the water coming FROM?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's the upstairs ceiling's problem, Barry. Carol, you're next. Quote, I smell gas near my water heater.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Carol, a smell is just a color you can't see yet. Paint the heater a calming sage green. Light a nice candle for the odor.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A CANDLE? Carol, do NOT light a candle, please call a...

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Relax, Barry. <p:0.3> The candle dries the paint faster.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Update from Maureen, the ceiling lady. Quote, painted over it like you said. New stain came through, so I painted that. End quote. <p:0.3> Twelve coats in, Barry. That ceiling'll outlive the house.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The house she can no longer enter.
